Completely rented buy for solid cash flow in a market with steady demand. Enjoy natural gas hot air heat, public utilities, vinyl/aluminum exterior, and a generous lot with room for outdoor enjoyment.
Located near amenities, parks, and major routes, this property is a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, house hackers, or savvy investors looking to capitalize on Niagara Falls’ revitalization.
